Chapter 11 / 12ARCHITECTURE

Separate facts, inference and unknowns.

A plausible answer is not evidence. Preserve disagreements, missing coverage and source limitations through synthesis.

Make uncertainty actionable

“Refresh behavior unknown” is useful only with the affected API, missing scenario and attempted sources. Ask a focused follow-up or perform targeted research when it can change the answer.

Do not hide contradictions

Compare date, version, authority and scope before resolving conflicting sources. If unresolved, show both positions and explain the limitation. Numeric confidence without calibration is not proof.

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
